steps.title: 合流區雨水入口：集水面積與逕流量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Combined-catchment storm entry: Catchment area and runoff volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 合流區雨水入口：集水面積與逕流量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Combined-catchment storm entry: Catchment area and runoff volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「合流區雨水入口」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at combined-catchment storm entry.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
steps.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「合流區雨水入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for combined-catchment storm entry; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.titleEn: Gravity tunnel conveyance: Gravity conveyance and roughness: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 隧道重力輸送：重力輸送與粗糙度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Gravity tunnel conveyance: Gravity conveyance and roughness and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: Manning 模型以水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度表示明渠平均輸送能力；加粗表面會降低同水位的流量。本單元在「隧道重力輸送」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: The Manning model relates open-channel capacity to hydraulic radius, slope and roughness; greater roughness reduces discharge at the same depth. Examine this relationship at gravity tunnel conveyance.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：A=4 m²、R=0.8 m、S=0.001、n=0.015。公式 Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2)；代入 (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s。適用邊界：穩定均勻明渠近似；滿管壓力、回水與跌水需另建模。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: A=4 m², R=0.8 m, S=0.001 and n=0.015. Formula Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2); substitution (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s. Boundary: Steady uniform open-channel approximation; pressure flow, backwater and drops require separate models.
steps.failure: 沉積與生物膜改變粗糙度，沿用初建值可能高估能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Sediment and biofilm alter roughness; an as-built value may overestimate capacity. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 量測縱坡與斷面，校準不同水位的流量曲線。在離線場景為「隧道重力輸送」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Measure slope and section and calibrate the discharge curve at several depths. Build an offline evidence table for gravity tunnel conveyance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 雨後抽送恢復容量：提升水頭與電力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Post-storm pumping recovery: Lift head and electrical power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 雨後抽送恢復容量：提升水頭與電力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Post-storm pumping recovery: Lift head and electrical power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「雨後抽送恢復容量」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at post-storm pumping recovery.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
steps.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「雨後抽送恢復容量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for post-storm pumping recovery; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instructionEn: A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.
steps.failure: 兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「截流系統備援」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for interception-system redundancy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.text: 先點選「截流系統備援」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the interception-system redundancy measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
